Maria (Capacity PM): Quick sync — Q3 forecast shows a 38% token/hr increase from marketing campaigns. Need to decide H100 vs H200 vs L40S reservations for Jun–Aug. Thoughts on lead times and cost curve? @kevin @li
Kevin (Infra Eng): H200 lead times still ~12-16 weeks in our regions, especially EU. H100 ~8-12. L40S available short notice but has lower perf/cost ratio for long sequences. :thinking:
Sam (SRE): cluster-wise, H200 nodes push higher temp profiles on racks — we'd need extra cooling checks if we bump by +50 racks. Also recommend pre-warmed pool (20%) to avoid cold-start tail latency.
Li (Procurement): We can chase an earlier slot if we commit to a 12-month reservation or sign a LOI. Discount tier jumps at 6k GPU-hours/month. Need committed hours numbers.
Kevin (Infra Eng): Proposal: reserve baseline L40S for steady embeddings + burst H200 for generation. Could do 60/40 split. Will run perf sims next 48h.
Maria (Capacity PM): 60/40 sounds plausible. Can you run throughput projections for a mixed workload (prompt avg 512 tokens, 10% long-tail 4k)?
Kevin (Infra Eng): Yep — I'll drop the sim + CSV by EOD. Quick note: if we prefer H100 over H200 we lose some perf on 4k sequences but get cost wins on 1k. Tradeoffs attached.
Sam (SRE): Operational todo: add `prewarm_pool_size` to infra config for each cluster and enable KV cache warmers. Example: `kv_warmer --model all --workers 12`
infra-bot: Calendar event created: "Hardware booking sync — Jun/Jul window" scheduled 2026-03-28 15:00 UTC
Maria (Capacity PM): Ok, let's aim to finalize committed-hours by Fri. @li can you sketch the LOI language and discount thresholds? :pray:
Li (Procurement): On it. Will post a template and numbers in #procurement today.
Maria (Capacity PM): Thanks — we'll review Kevin's sims and reconvene. :white_check_mark:
